item.title: Two trailers stolen in Warren County, says sheriff
item.description: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – The Warren County Sheriff’s Office is investigating two thefts. Sheriff Brett Hightower says two trailers were reported stolen between Friday and Saturday. Both trailers were stolen in northern Warren County. Call the Warren County Sheriff’s Office at 270-842- 1633 with any information regarding the case.
